A [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Farstine)|bounty hunter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] had a younger '''brother''' who [[Death/Legends|died]] at an early age. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] eventually met an orphaned [[Unidentified child (Farstine)|child]] on [[Farstine]]; reminded of their brother, the hunter took charge of the [[Youngling/Legends|child]].<ref name="RPG" />
